# What is knowable, per jurisdiction

<!-- GENERATED by backend/scripts/generate_knowability_doc.py from backend/opencheck/data/jurisdictions.json — edit the Notion table "Beneficial ownership access status", run sync_jurisdictions.py, then regenerate. -->

One statement per jurisdiction of what its registers publish about beneficial owners, who may see it, and what OpenCheck reads of it (Phase 223). The facts are Stephen's, maintained in the Notion database *Beneficial ownership access status*; the sentence is generated by `opencheck/knowability.py` and is the one the QuickCheck verdict strip, the PDF/Markdown report, the MCP `summary` and the entity pages will carry. It describes and dates; it never judges — see the module docstring for the three rules and the banned-vocabulary guard.

Data generated 2026-10-07T14:19:52+00:00; sentences rendered as of 2026-10-07. **46 of 55 rows verified by Stephen** (a `Last verified` date in the table); the other 9 are drafts from his trackers and are marked *unverified* below.

It records holders of at least 10 per cent (10%), as exact holdings, down to the ultimate natural person. OpenCheck reads no Botswana register, so an owner absent from this report says nothing about what Botswana holds.

Threshold, in full (CIPA Beneficial Ownership Guidelines 2026): “The legal person must take reasonable steps to identify the natural person(s) who owns or controls it, either through owning or controlling at least 10 per cent (10%) of its shares or voting rights or other ownership interest.” Register pages publish BO names, nationalities, addresses, interest type and share, with start and end dates; no dates of birth seen. Legal basis: Companies Act Cap. 42:01 as amended in 2018 (ss. 21, 345) and 2025 (Act No. 3 of 2025: s. 329(1) substantial-shareholder threshold five to 10 per cent; nominee and nominator defined; s. 329A nominee disclosure); FIA 2022 s. 2; FI Regulations 2022 reg. 7. |

| Pending changes | By 1 Jan 2027 UR must auto-restrict shareholder/owner records of BOs already restricted as minors/limited-capacity (transitional provision). Apartment owners' associations brought into BO disclosure 5 Jan 2026; transitional filings due 1 Oct 2026.
